name: Upflow
summary: Accounts receivable platform for B2B finance teams: collections across email, SMS, calls and letters run by configurable agents, a payment portal, and cash application. For agents: a read-only hosted MCP server (OAuth, allowlisted clients, enabled per organization by an admin) and a REST API with key and secret. Claims a 30% average DSO reduction within three months and publishes no method for it.

payments.notes: Read 2026-11-12: a free Discover plan (dashboard and insights); five paid tiers by yearly invoiced value, each "Ask for a quote". Upflow Payments add-on: $390/month platform fee, then cards 3.5% + $0.30, ACH 0.8% capped at $5. The free plan names no collections, API or MCP. Nothing prices a call.

agentAccess.notes: MCP at api.upflow.io/mcp: keyless initialize 401 invalid_token, scope mcp:read, RFC 9728 metadata (2026-11-11). Docs: tokens read-only, clients allowlisted, an admin enables MCP per organization. A registration endpoint is advertised but was not tried. REST API: X-Api-Key and X-Api-Secret.

jobs.summary: Chases overdue invoices on configured workflows across email, SMS, calls and letters, with agents from suggestion-only to autonomous. Claims a 30% average DSO cut in three months, method unpublished. Recovery within 30 days, write-off, failed-charge recovery and chases per recovery unpublished.
